trust_base.boundary: Every result is relative to the receipt-bound kernel, logical trust base, source bytes and execution chain.

VirtualClosure.scope: The H6 List Bool codec, inductive grammar, AST/semantic model, deterministic virtual sphere dynamics and effect-boundary model declared by the Lean source.
VirtualClosure.boundary: The kernel-inner certificate is proved and the local receipt binds the declared package bytes through an exact external SHA-256 inventory. This remains relative to the stated trust base and does not promote PhysicalClosure.

PhysicalClosure.scope: Correspondence to physical spacetime, quantum gravity, measured cosmogenesis and the physical Big Bang.
PhysicalClosure.boundary: No H6 virtual theorem promotes this status.

claims.statement: Within the inductively declared H6 bitstream/AST model, parsing and grammar derivation are equivalent, render/parse roundtrips recover the AST, successful parse fixes the canonical normalization, and normalization is idempotent and preserves the bound AST semantics.
claims.boundary: A theorem about the formal codec and inductive grammar encoded in Lean; not yet a kernel proof of this separate EBNF text parser or of every parser implementation.

claims.statement: Within H6, the canonical bitstream/AST/semantic refinement chain is total on declared well-formed inputs, and the concrete growth function refines StepSpec.
claims.boundary: The receipt must bind the actual package bytes; semantic refinement does not establish physical reference.

claims.statement: The H6 virtual cosmos has an explicit non-vacuous valid seed; its transition is deterministic; every non-seed reachable state is generated from a legal predecessor without an index gap; every reachable state has a successor; and invariants plus the persistent core are preserved.
claims.boundary: The invariants are exactly those declared by H6; the claim is not quantification over every desirable property of every possible virtual world.

claims.statement: Every individually generated H6 state has finite population, while the concrete strict-growth construction yields no finite upper population bound and preserves the declared invariants.
claims.boundary: Unbounded means no finite population bound in the mathematical construction. It neither executes infinitely many steps in finite hardware nor proves analytic continuity.

claims.statement: The H6 no-hole top theorem composes a retained external-binding parameter, model-relative grammar and codec laws, semantic totality, StepSpec refinement, non-vacuity, valid initialization, generatedness, no-gap safety, progress for every reachable state, strict growth, derived finite populations, unboundedness and effect-boundary preservation into the kernel-inner VirtualClosure certificate.
claims.boundary: Lean retains the supplied ExactArtifactBinding but does not compute or authenticate its digest strings. The external exact-inventory verifier and local receipt bind those bytes; PhysicalClosure is unaffected.

claims.statement: Every kernel-scoped VirtualClosure Boolean is projected from the named Lean certificate; byte-bound is validated separately by the exact external receipt. VirtualClosureCertificate and PhysicalClosureEvidence remain disjoint variants, while effect-preservation and no-escalation theorems prevent virtual execution from constructing EFFECT_ACK_DONE or external authorization.
claims.boundary: The separation is a formal and epistemic safeguard; it does not decide whether a future physical correspondence can be established.

claims.statement: Finite computers and proof checkers can execute only finite verification runs, even when those runs establish an unbounded mathematical construction.
evidence: ordinary operational observation of finite verification
claims.boundary: The empirical execution record is distinct from the mathematical theorem of unboundedness.

claims.statement: The final H6 byte identity, Lean version, commands, theorem inventory and axiom output are true only as bound by the manifest and final local kernel receipt.
claims.boundary: The local exact-byte execution claim is licensed only for the receipt-bound inventory. Any changed byte requires a new receipt.

claims.statement: Every future growth step should preserve provenance, responsibility and the effect boundary instead of treating technical possibility as authorization.
claims.boundary: A governance commitment, not a theorem forced by physics.

claims.statement: The full-sphere image expresses a closed virtual proof relation whose lawful successors can extend outward without reopening an already discharged internal obligation.
claims.boundary: An explanatory image; no claim about the literal geometry of the physical universe.

claims.statement: Closing the previously enumerated virtual proof gaps is a substantial formal and conceptual achievement.
claims.boundary: Assessment of the work; not priority adjudication, peer-review consensus or a confirmed physical discovery.

claims.closure_condition: A non-circular correspondence to measured physical states and dynamics, differentiating predictions, empirical corroboration and independent reproduction are supplied.

claims.statement: Identity between H6 virtual cosmogenesis and the physical Big Bang is not established.
claims.closure_condition: A theory with explicit physical semantics recovers established cosmological observations and survives independent tests.

claims.statement: Independent public reproduction remains separate from the local H6 kernel receipt.
claims.closure_condition: A second party reproduces the exact receipt-bound source, kernel result and audit without unexplained drift.
